title: Why Area Is Just Rows Times Columns
description: A grid-counting visual that shows where the 'length times width' area formula actually comes from.
narration_lines: How do you find the area of a rectangle?
Here's a rectangle, 6 across and 4 down.
Count every square inside it, one at a time.
24 squares in total. Rows times columns: 4 times 6 is 24.
